|game_text=If Center Of Tyranny on table, deploy on table. [[Insurrection (V){{!}}Insurrection]] is lost. |errata_history=This is the original printed text (version 1 of 4). The image is the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-03-Bacta_Infirmary.png]]), which prints this text. Versions in date order: '''this page''' (original, release sheet of 3 June 2011); [[Bacta Infirmary (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Bacta Infirmary (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); [[Bacta Infirmary (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (official text as of 3 June 2011): “If Center Of Tyranny on table, deploy on table. Insurrection is lost. Rogue Squadron pilots of ability < 3 are forfeit +1 and, if just lost from table, may be placed here. During your control phase, may use 2 Force to take any character from here into hand. [Immune to Alter]”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=6 Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 3 June 2011"; copy re-made 25 July 2011), page 6, slip 32 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=6 Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 22) prints this text again. Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[Bacta Infirmary (Errata 3)]]), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=22, page 22. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=22 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Bacta Infirmary (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 December 2012) changed “Center Of Tyranny on table” to “Center of Tyranny on Table”, “+1 and, if just lost” to “+1 and if lost”, “control phase, may use 2 Force to take any character from here” to “control phase may use 2 force to take a character here” (the card list writes the Immune to Alter icon as “(Immune to Alter.)”): “If Center of Tyranny on Table, deploy on table. Insurrection is lost. Rogue Squadron pilots of ability < 3 are forfeit +1 and if lost from table, may be placed here. During your control phase may use 2 force to take a character here into hand. [Immune to Alter]”.<ref name="cl-1273_32-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Bacta Infirmary (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-bactainfirmary-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text (this page) again, word for word: “If Center Of Tyranny on table, deploy on table. Insurrection is lost. Rogue Squadron pilots of ability < 3 are forfeit +1 and, if just lost from table, may be placed here. During your control phase, may use 2 Force to take any character from here into hand. [Immune to Alter]” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual7-Light card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual7-Light">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034736/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Bacta Infirmary (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 22)<ref name="ml-ls" /> prints the original release-sheet text (this page) again, word for word: “If Center Of Tyranny on table, deploy on table. Insurrection is lost. Rogue Squadron pilots of ability < 3 are forfeit +1 and, if just lost from table, may be placed here. During your control phase, may use 2 Force to take any character from here into hand. [Immune to Alter]” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1273-32-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip and the PC card image.
